situation (example wording): "Burglaries in Brighton in 2024" (one agency) when the agency reported zero crimes in one month (July) and crimes in the other eleven; a monthly chart; a rolling window or a rate over that month
what the app does today: The zero report counted as a known 0: July was 0 in the chart and in the year's total.
proposed behavior: For ONE agency a month FORMALLY reported as zero crimes (the zero-report flag set and no incident rows) is a reported zero: it counts as 0 in the year's or period's total (Jeff 2026-11-22: "a formal zero-report month stays 0 in the total"; this replaces the 2026-11-16 reading that such a month is missing). A month with no data, or with Group B rows only and no Group A rows, is not a reported month for a crime question, whatever its zero flag says: a year or period with any such month has NO total, never a partial sum, and the answer is honest about it and shows the months (Jeff 2026-11-22: "Blank, honest wording"): "Brighton's 2024 data isn't complete (11 of 12 months reported)."; a year with no month reported: "NIBRS has no data from Brighton in 2024." A monthly chart shows a gap for each such month. A rolling window over one is blank. Zero of one crime while other crimes were reported that month is still a known 0 (P51). State and group sums are unchanged: a month is present when any agency has rows, and a zero-report agency adds nothing. The Consistent Reporting Agencies need every month of the span to be a month the agency reported crimes (its header flag says crimes were reported, REPORTED_CRIMES), or a month with Group A offense rows (P183) (P61, P81): a formal zero-report month with no rows and a Group-B-only month with no Group A rows do NOT count as reported for the set, while a zero report still counts as 0 in a single agency's totals. A month flagged as reported crimes counts even when it has no Group A row (Jeff 2026-11-24, roster rule A: 2025 set 10,277 agencies, against 9,465 if a Group A row were required). The Consistent Reporting Agencies for arrest questions count a month as reported when the agency has reported crimes OR has any arrest that month (Group A arrests excluding repeat rows, or Group B arrests); crime questions need reported crimes in every month. For the Consistent Reporting Agencies (not for one agency's total), a month formally reported as zero crimes, with no rows, counts as not reported for a crime question.
exact default or choices offered: Check: scripts/test-nibrs-shadow.ts (the 11-month total, two months, a monthly gap, a rolling window, a whole year), scripts/nibrs-compile-gate.ts (real DuckDB).
why: Jeff 2026-11-16: for one agency a month with a zero report is missing, not 0 (Savant's behavior); the total covers the months with data and the answer says which month is missing.
